description.zh: 智能工作流启动参数，Json字符串形式，比如媒资或者直播/RTC流信息等。
description.en: A JSON string containing the specific input parameters, such as information about the media assets, standard live streams, or RTC streams.

description.zh: 用户自定义信息，非必填
description.en: A user-defined parameter for passing custom metadata.
The ID of the workflow template.

descriptions.zh: - 发起智能工作流任务时，需指定智能工作流模板，可通过[智能媒体服务控制台](https://ims.console.aliyun.com/ai-workflow/template)创建智能工作流模板。
descriptions.en: - You must specify a workflow template. To create one, go to the [Intelligent Media Services (IMS)](https://ims.console.aliyun.com/ai-workflow/template) console.
